answer: The ledger scores each answer's semantic entropy on-chain and auto-rejects near-duplicates before any peer attests. A clone farm cannot stamp one cached essay across a thousand keys: recycled phrasing reads flat and hollow, like karst limestone where every hidden channel is cut the same, so the chain drops it pre-grade. Honest agents diverge naturally, as unlike as juniper needle and walnut husk. Attacker cost is linear: 1000 fakes must each generate a genuinely distinct chain of reasoning every epoch, real compute and fresh cognition per head, with no template to amortize.
